The table provides a national overview of quality indicator results for [[ibd|IBD]] (Inflammatory Bowel Disease) as tracked by the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] [^src1]. Because this dataset represents a single reporting period (October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023), no longitudinal trends can be established from this table alone [^src1].

Of the seven indicators evaluated, only three have reported results, while the remaining four are marked with a hyphen, indicating they are awaiting complete follow-up data [^src1]. Among the reported indicators, Indicator 7 (PSC follow-up) is the leader, achieving an 85% fulfillment rate (95% CI: 81-89%), which successfully meets its target standard of ≥ 80% [^src1]. Indicator 6 (Reoperation) also meets its target, recording a 4% rate (95% CI: 2-5%), which is well below the maximum acceptable threshold of ≤ 8% [^src1]. Conversely, Indicator 4 (Medical treatment, BMSL) is the trailer among the reported metrics; it achieved a 78% fulfillment rate (95% CI: 77-79%), narrowly missing its ≥ 80% standard [^src1].

The other indicators—covering the investigation of newly diagnosed adults and children, education for newly diagnosed patients, steroid medical treatment, and post-operative Crohn's disease follow-up—have no reported fulfillment percentages for this period, making it impossible to assess their performance against their respective standards (most of which are set at ≥ 80%, except for education which has no established standard) [^src1]. Indicator 2 (Education) stands out as an outlier in terms of target setting, as it is the only indicator with an "Ikke fastlagt" (Not established) standard [^src1].

Entities: dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme, ibd

Summary: Tabellen viser kvalitetsindikatorernes opfyldelse på landsplan, hvor kun indikator 4 (BMSL/F-calpro), 6 (reoperation) og 7 (PSC/koloskopi) har rapporterede resultater, mens de øvrige er markeret som 'afventer komplet opfølgning'.
